note: The Hobie 16's rebuild (docs/hobie16-2 on). Slice 1 builds the two hulls, as one object so the loop measures her overall beam; slice 2 adds the platform (H16Platform_ objects), slice 3 the rudders (H16Rudder_ and H16Tiller_ objects), slices 4 and 5 the rig and sails, slice 6 the hardware. Rules as in sections_j22.json: an entry ending in '_' or '*' is a name prefix, any other an exact name; unmatched is 'other'.
joins_note: Slice 2: the four bosses moulded round the pylons sit on the hulls' decks, their feet 4 mm under the crowned deck all round (H16Platform_Boss|H16_Hull). The pylons stand in the bosses and the frame's tubes run into the castings' sleeves and heads; those are one object (H16Platform_Frame), so they are overlaps inside a part, not joins. Slice 3: the gudgeons' plates stand 2 mm into the transoms (H16Rudder_Gudgeons|H16_Hull). The rudders turn on the gudgeons' eyes, so they touch the gudgeons, not the hull; the tiller crossbar and the arms meet inside the end fittings.
